name: Crookhead Malachite Tundra, Hearth-Ring Melt-Wells and Silent Vales Pass (station head): subalpine krummholz larch and moraine tarn country with malachite-teal and rust-ochre mineral-rind cushion-heaths, frost-glass silica sedges, thermogenic +15 degC hearth-ring rosettes melting 1-2 m circular snow wells ringed by cryo-snow algae, and bone-white wind-fluted alpine seed-chimneys crossing The Great Hush
